players.product: VCSEL / FP / DFB laser and PIN / APD photodiode chips, TO-cans, OSAs and COB / AOC optical modules for data-center optics; CW-laser and photodetector epitaxy and wafer foundry services for silicon-photonics modules

quarterly_data.signal: 2025 operating revenue was NT$683,276 thousand, up 19% from NT$573,752 thousand in 2024; gross profit NT$92,159 thousand (2024: NT$23,718 thousand); net loss narrowed to NT$160,535 thousand from NT$254,875 thousand; basic loss per share NT$1.40. Gross profit rose on revenue growth from silicon photonics (SiPh) foundry services for cloud data centers.
quarterly_data.figure: revenue NT$683,276 thousand (+19%); gross profit NT$92,159 thousand; net loss NT$160,535 thousand

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 projected revenue mix (based on market forecasts and customer information): silicon photonics foundry services for cloud data centers 40.2%, optical communication data transmission 34.5%, intelligent sensing 18.7%, high-power components 3.3%, other 3.3%. Upstream, the company is expanding capacity for silicon-photonics optoelectronic components, providing epitaxial growth and foundry services for high-power continuous-wave (CW) lasers and high-speed photodetectors; it provides OEM/ODM foundry services for CW lasers with well-known domestic and international companies.
quarterly_data.figure: SiPh foundry services 40.2% of projected 2026 revenue

quarterly_data.signal: R&D: developed 112G (50 Gbaud) VCSEL/PD components for short-reach links, now in sample validation for 400G/800G optical transceiver modules; developed a 1310 nm 100G APD with leading global 5G/6G equipment providers; plans to significantly increase R&D on critical components for 800G and 1.6T optical transceiver modules.
quarterly_data.figure: 112G (50 Gbaud) VCSEL/PD in sample validation for 400G/800G modules

quarterly_data.signal: Developed a chip-on-board (COB) packaging platform coupling silicon photonics chips to fiber arrays with its single six-axis optical coupling technology at 1 um alignment precision; the company will co-develop silicon photonics products and co-packaged optics (CPO) with strategic partners.

Customer concentration (codes only): T0436 NT$82,922 thousand (12% of 2025 net sales), E0113 NT$79,260 thousand (12%), T0124 NT$70,044 thousand (10%); 2025 sales were 60% domestic (Taiwan) and 40% export. Sales by product: chips and components 63%, optical transmission and connection modules 28%, others 9%.
quarterly_data.figure: T0436 12%, E0113 12%, T0124 10% of 2025 net sales; domestic 60%

Truelight.why: Makes VCSEL / laser and PD / APD chips, TO-cans, OSAs and COB modules for optical transceivers, plus CW-laser and photodetector epitaxy / foundry services for silicon-photonics modules in cloud data centers; it projects 40.2% of 2026 revenue from silicon photonics foundry services for cloud data centers.
Truelight.evidence: Truelight annual report: 2025 Annual Report (05-08-2026): 'Increase in net gross profit: Due to revenue growth from silicon photonics (SiPh) foundry services for cloud data centers'; 'providing epitaxial growth and foundry services for high-power continuous-wave (CW) lasers and high-speed photodetectors'.
